name: TEJ PIM-frontend-codex-package
description: TEJ PIM frontend Codex execution package — drop into apps/web/src/ and feed ui-tasks.json one sprint at a time

files.CODEX_UI.md: Main instruction file — read before every sprint
files.ui-tasks.json: All 37 tasks across 10 sprints with acceptance criteria and gate checks
files.src/lib/tokens.ts: Design tokens — colors, badge states, thresholds. SOURCE OF TRUTH.
files.src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions — cn(), relativeTime(), maskEmail(), highestSeverity()
files.src/lib/auth-store.ts: Zustand auth store — token in memory only
files.src/api/client.ts: Axios instance with 402, 401 refresh, 423 lockout interceptors
files.src/i18n/keys.ts: All i18n key constants — use K.x in every component
files.src/hooks/index.ts: Core hooks: usePlanUsage, useUnsavedChanges, useOnlineStatus, useLocalStorage
files.src/components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx: Semantic status badge with text label always visible
files.src/components/ui/CompletenessRing.tsx: SVG completeness arc with full accessibility
files.src/components/ui/ConnectorCard.tsx: Single source of truth for connector status display
files.src/components/billing/PlanLimitModal.ts: Global 402 handler — shown instead of error toast
